item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 18/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a maritime airstream, the weather will be humid and foggy over the coastal areas of Guangdong in the next few days. It will be rather warm during the day. The northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week and early next week. Temperatures will fall progressively over the region.
